name: How to Plan Your Multi-Room Remodel

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Planning a multi-room remodel for your East Bay home can feel like a lot, but breaking it down makes it much more manageable. First off, you'll want to clearly define your goals for each room. What do you want to achieve with this renovation? Are you looking for better flow, more functionality, or a fresh aesthetic?

step.name: Step 2
step.text: Next, think about the sequence. Which spaces make the most sense to tackle first? Sometimes, getting the messier work done in one area before moving to another can save a lot of headaches. It’s also super important to create a unified design plan. You don’t want your rooms to feel disconnected once the work is done. This means thinking about how colors, materials, and styles will transition from one space to the next.

step.name: Step 3
step.text: Before any work starts, make sure you get an itemized estimate. This should include allowances for finishes and fixtures, and a clear understanding of how any changes made during the project will affect the cost and timeline. This transparency is key to avoiding budget surprises. Getting this groundwork laid out properly with an experienced contractor, like Frasheski Construction, sets your project up for success.
